scripts.dev: pnpm --filter ./angular build && pnpm --filter ./electron build && pnpm --dir electron exec electron ../dist/app
scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && simple-git-hooks && pnpm --dir verify exec playwright install chromium && node tools/python.mjs setup
scripts.build: pnpm -r build && node tools/python.mjs -m compileall -q python/app
scripts.verify: pnpm build && pnpm --dir verify exec playwright test
scripts.lint: eslint . && node tools/check-pins.mjs && node tools/check-i18n-keys.mjs && node tools/python.mjs -m ruff check python
scripts.format: prettier --write . && node tools/python.mjs -m ruff format python
scripts.format:check: node tools/check-format.mjs && node tools/python.mjs -m ruff format --check python
